description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Possessed Skaab and exiling Ephemerate.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
